title: WPSS/2373/2018 of Sanjay Kumar Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 2373 of 2018
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate for
the petitioner.
 Mr. M.C. Tewari, Deputy
Advocate General for the State of
Uttarakhand.
 Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
 Petitioner has approached this
Court seeking the following relief:
ìi. Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of certiorari for quashing the
impugned order dated 09.02.2018
passed by respondent no.3, Director of
Education (Basic), Nanoorkhera,
Dehradun Uttarakhand, in relation to
the recovery of excess payment and
fresh fixation of the salary to the lower
pay scale.
ii. Issue a other writ order or direction,
in the nature of mandamus directing the
respondents to pay the salary to the
petitioner which they was getting on the
basis of 7th pay commission from the
year 2017 i.e. pay scale of Rs. 9,300/- to
Rs.34,800/-.î
Learned counsel for the
petitioner submits that the
controversy involved in this case is
squarely covered by the judgment
given by the Coordinate Bench of
this Court on 20.06.2018 in Writ
Petition (S/S) No.562 of 2018.
Learned Deputy Advocate
General submitted that so far prayer
no.1 is concerned, case of the
petitioner is covered but prayer no.2
is not covered by that judgment.

At this stage, leaned counsel
for the petitioner seeks permission
to withdraw the petition so far
prayer no.2 is concerned with liberty
to avail appropriate remedy.
Permission is granted.
The writ petition is dismissed
as withdrawn so far prayer no.2 is
concerned with liberty to avail
appropriate remedy. So far prayer
no.1 is concerned, it is admitted by
the counsel for the parties that the
controversy involved in this petition
is squarely covered by the judgment
given by the Coordinate Bench of
this Court on 20.06.2018 in Writ
Petition (S/S) No.562 of 2018.
Therefore, the writ petition is
disposed of in terms of the judgment
given by the Coordinate Bench of
this Court on 20.06.2018 in Writ
Petition (S/S) No.562 of 2018.
